title: The Bear Who Became a Corporal 🐻 #shorts
description:
In 1942, Polish soldiers adopted an orphaned bear cub in Iran and named him Wojtek. When pets were banned from the transport ship, they enlisted him. At Monte Cassino he carried crates of artillery shells, and the army promoted him to corporal.

Believe It Or Bear: true stories, twist endings. Follow for more.
